section.title: Control the desktop
section.subtitle: Look at the screen, click buttons and type to drive the Windows desktop; looking can skip approval, acting asks every time
field.maxEdge.label: Longest screenshot edge
field.maxEdge.help: In pixels; very wide screens are scaled down proportionally. Smaller numbers save tokens, but text may get blurry.
field.format.label: Screenshot encoding
field.quality.label: JPEG quality
field.quality.help: Only applies when the encoding is JPEG.
field.actionDelayMs.label: Delay between actions
field.actionDelayMs.help: In milliseconds; gives the target application time to react and keeps its input from merging.
field.actionsPerScreenshot.label: Action limit since the last screenshot
field.actionsPerScreenshot.help: 0 means no limit; past the limit a fresh screenshot is required, because the screen may have changed.
field.allowedApps.label: Application allowlist
field.allowedApps.placeholder: Empty = no limit; for example chrome,Code,Teams
field.allowedApps.help: Matches the process name or title of the foreground window by containment; separate several with commas. Actions on any other application are refused outright.
field.disabledActions.label: Disabled actions
field.lookWithoutApproval.label: Look at the screen without approval
field.lookWithoutApproval.help: Once on, screenshots, accessibility reads, pointer checks and window/application/display listings go through the read-only tools with no approval card; clicking, typing, key presses and scrolling still ask every time.
field.auditEnabled.label: Separate audit log
field.auditEnabled.help: Every action writes one line to ~/.dsc/audit/computer-use.jsonl (time / action / target / result / whether it was approved).
field.whoIsFront.label: Show the foreground window
field.whoIsFront.help: Use it to check what belongs in the allowlist.
field.stop.label: Emergency stop
field.stop.help: Kills every running UI child process and pauses the action surface; the same as the model's stop action.
field.resume.label: Resume desktop control
field.resume.help: Use it to recover after an emergency stop; the next action still needs approval.
save.maxEdgeNumber: The longest screenshot edge must be a number.
save.qualityNumber: JPEG quality must be a number.
save.actionDelayNumber: The delay between actions must be a number.
save.actionsPerScreenshotNumber: The action limit must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.whoIsFront: Foreground window: process {process}, title “{title}”. The allowlist matches either the process name or a fragment of the title.
action.stopped: Emergency stop: killed {count} running UI child processes and paused the desktop action surface.
action.resumed: Desktop control resumed; the next action still raises an approval card.
